300402.ja: ミアズミック・狛野真斗

30041.desc:
A Corrupted with rich combat experience, equally skilled in offense and defense, moving with agility. It excels at lurking in hidden spots, launching the most efficient attacks targeting weak points.

I should have recorded more - its behavioral patterns, the haunting song that follows it like a shadow, things like that... But let's leave it at that, just like the half-finished portrait in Lucia's book.

"One little star, up high. Two little stars, float by. Three little stars, it's time to go and hide."
30041.ja: ワンダリングハンター

30042.desc:
Tainted miasma and a corrupt will pull the strings. The beast still retains its instinct to roam and prowl, yet the human form upon its back has lost all reason. Only a faint trace of sorrow remains. At times, he slashes through the dark fog with his blade; at others, he commands the beast's gaping jaws to rend the earth itself. His strikes are precise, devoid of the gentle humanity he once held — like a puppet pulled by the tattered remnants of a nightmare.
Only when a streak of red ribbon flashes across his senses does his sword arm falter for an instant — as though that lingering sorrow had, for a heartbeat, tightened around his corroded soul.

"As for the two, who is truly controlling whom... The "person" on its back is my real prisoner."
"Despair should be utilized to its fullest until the very end, shouldn't it?"
30042.ja: 悪夢に縛られし者・葉釈淵

30044.desc:
"All who hear the sound shall behold the form of truth." —Even if that truth is nothing more than an illusion dredged from delirious murmurs.
Perhaps it once had a name, a history, a self. For reasons unknown, it willingly stepped into a dark chamber one day, offering its ears, its eyes, even its mind to become a vessel existing solely to transmit a certain sound. It mistook the whispers of something within a Hollow for divine revelation, seeing itself as the voice through which "It" spoke directly to the mortal world. When its prey grows careless, that voice, eerily familiar, undeniably their own, rings within their mind, impossible to resist.
Yet in those brief pauses between its divine utterances, when the mind resists the murmurs and shatters the delusion, does it, in turn, feel a faint sting of human emotion?
To the very end, it pulsed with the remnants of an unspoken "truth." No rage, no terror — just a solemn, almost sacred determination, until the last note faded into silence along with its lifeless shell.

"The 'Covenant Guardian'? It clings to that disgusting voice as if upholding divine law. Like some idiot convinced they'd found their way home, only to become a tombstone carved from sound." "But really... what's the use in despising the vessel? If there's blame to be had, it belongs to whatever makes the sound."
30044.ja: サクリファイス・コヴェナント・ガーディアン

30045.desc:
A fallen creation, reshaped in the depths of impure darkness.
The "Rampant Brute," once a symbol of absolute violence, has become a prisoner to the Miasma. Its mechanical armor has nearly fused with flesh, consciousness completely shattered, leaving only raw destructive instinct to lash out and crush everything it encounters within the Hollows.
Thanks to the street workout culture it once worshipped in life, fragments of muscle memory still carry out warped "training routines," but every application of force tears apart its own structure, destroying any trace of strength's beauty.
"Boss? What're you doing?! Boss!"
"The fighting moves you taught, the workout techniques — this ain't it... You're not my boss. I won't accept this!"
30045.ja: ミアズミック・剛力横暴者

30046.desc:
Modified from the military Autonomous Support Unit "Terror Raptor," the "anti-Void Hunter mech" is a highly classified weapon painstakingly developed by Rusty Cliff Corp.
Its original military identifier has long been erased, as if it were never meant to leave behind any tracks to retrace from the very beginning.
Claimed to be capable of countering Void Hunter-Rank fighters, the mech is still in its prototype phase, and its actual combat capabilities fall far short of its terrifying name. However, both its ammunition power and armor specs break through conventional military thresholds. Without a doubt, this steel behemoth possesses unparalleled killing efficiency, a testament to the "relentless efforts" TOPS has made to breach the city administration's long-standing military control.
"The 'anti-Void Hunter mech'... A rarely worthy opponent indeed. But sorry! As always, the passing-by knight has once again saved New Eridu."
"Billy, hurry up! We're leaving!"
"So soon?! Wait a sec! I still have a few more lines... Ugh, never mind, wait for me!"
30046.ja: テラー・ラプトル・「エグゼキューター」

30047.desc:
A reliable friend, a seasoned fighter, and the very first mentor on the road to combat.
Look! The badge of the shining galaxy is resonating!
Listen! A powerful beat is ringing!
Engines roar, gunfire sparks, and the warm-up is finally over. The Knight hauls in his speaker and joins the battlefield. Are you ready, my friend? It's showtime!
"Just as expected of the Manager! Time to get serious!" "No way, I'm going up against The Champion? For real?"

30048.desc:
A special heavy combat unit fielded by the Roscaelifer Airspace Patrol. The culmination of the Airspace Patrol's military technology, it is stationed in the Energy Module facilities on the lower levels of the floating island.
During patrol duty, it remains in a fixed turret configuration, providing thunderous heavy fire support to ground forces. When its stabilized base transforms into a quadrupedal frame, it becomes a highly mobile heavy combat mech capable of dominating the battlefield.
It serves as a reliable defensive line against Ethereal incursions caused by Singularity Leakage. However, if affected by Ether Corruption and driven out of control, it becomes a severe threat to the Energy Hub.

"If any enemy dares to invade, I will deploy in mech form!"
30048.ja: 「エアスペース・センティネル」

30049.desc:
One who sheds a shattered shell in darkness, reborn through corruption, having forsaken its fallen form.

According to Hollow Investigative Association reports, Avarus is often jokingly called the embodiment of "the sin of gluttony" — its pot-bellied shape makes it look like a lazy lump, ready to nap at any moment.
But don't be fooled. Observations show that Avarus can curl into a ball and strike its targets with incredible speed.
As for how it keeps that round figure despite such intense activity? The Association is still scratching its head.
"The way it rolls reminds me of my pet hamster... just, y'know, a little bigger."
"More than just a little bigger..."

30050.desc:
One who sheds a shattered shell in darkness, reborn through corruption, having forsaken its fallen form.

In a desolate realm completely devoured by the Hollows, it slumbered until the arrival of "that power."
This aggressive and contaminating force, like a skilled yet malicious craftsman, refilled it with purer dark energy, transforming it into the current "Miasmic Scorpse."
Gradually, it seemed to grasp the trick of "existence" through mimicry. It could split its Miasma energy, creating multiple Mimics indistinguishable from the real thing.
These Mimics possess nearly identical offensive capabilities as the original, launching dazzling attacks from different angles to conceal the one lethal "truth."
When facing its encirclement, remember this well: all you see is illusion. All you feel is a trap.

"Only by stripping away all distractions and perceiving the one 'truth' can you find a glimmer of hope in this deadly dance of phantoms."

30051.desc:
Even among Ionized enemies renowned for their strange and uncanny qualities, Ionized Doppelgangers are exceptionally unique.
These entities can coat their bodies with a layer of special active Ether ions, enabling them to accurately replicate their target's form, often to a degree that makes it hard to tell the difference. Both in detail and texture, it is almost impossible to tell apart from the original.
Even more challenging is their ability to mimic the powerful and intimidating combat techniques of their targets.
No one knows where they obtain the information about the subjects they mimic. Some rumors suggest they can read minds, picking out the most suitable challengers from their opponent's memories, and then attack in that form.

"Nonsense! If it could really read my deepest fears, it would turn into a fierce middle-aged woman wielding a clothes hanger! That's right, I'm most afraid of my mom!"
30051.ja: ドッペルゲンガー・スターライト・ビリー

30052.desc:
An Ethereal that returned from the Cinderglow Lake.
Once a Dead End Butcher defeated by the Overlord Pompey, it was cast into the Cinderglow Lake. Yet instead of being reduced to ash, its body became encased in crystals formed from the burning byproducts of Ether.
Within the flames, its outer shell melted away and reformed again, each time gathering new layers of crystal. After enduring an endless torment resembling the depths of hell, it emerged with an armor-like body and gained the ability to move freely through fire.
After a long wandering through a world that seemed to have forgotten it, the creature finally discovered a spatial fissure at the bottom of the fire lake and entered the Divine Maze, Papago Hollow.
But that place was nothing more than another hell.
It appears to have suffered a crushing defeat. Ever since, it has been driven by an unknown force, obsessively collecting the special Ether scattered throughout the labyrinth.
Yet it can no longer tell whether what lies within is salvation... or blasphemy.

"Every time that walking bonfire comes through, the temperature goes through the roof. I want hazard pay for this!"

30053.desc:
A notorious Ethereal that prowls the Divine Maze of Papago Hollow.
If Papago Hollow's Hallucinogenic Soundscape is the trap that lures prey into the maze, then Ulidim is the hound that hunts down those unfortunate enough to become trapped inside it.
Ulidim's most terrifying ability is its power to emerge from any location or object within the Hollow's illusion, whether from a forgotten corner of the labyrinth or an old keepsake filled with a victim's cherished memories. The shock of its sudden appearance delivers a devastating blow to both body and mind, earning it the nickname "Hound of Old." Its true ability lies in ignoring the illusions woven by the Hallucinogenic Soundscape and moving freely through the Hollow itself.
Because of its terrifying nature and appearance, Ulidim is one of the most common and most feared threats encountered during Exploration Missions into Papago Hollow. Among the Bangboo stationed at Papago Outpost, even the mention of its name inspires fear, and frightening legends about Ulidim have spread from one Bangboo to another.
There are multiple Ulidim within the Hollow. Their routine task is to patrol designated areas and routes, maintaining the stability of the Hallucinogenic Soundscape. Should they detect an intruder interfering with the Hollow's stable expansion, they will immediately pursue and kill the offender.
"Within that labyrinth that has a beginning but no end, perhaps being devoured by the dreadful hound is a mercy in itself."

30054.desc:
An oversized combat unit deployed by High Ambitions Corp.
Staying true to the strategic principle of making the most of available resources, operatives salvaged large quantities of Porcelloy from Shrouded Reef to upgrade the Conqueror's structural materials.
Due to a lack of expertise in Porcelloy craftsmanship, the material wasn't perfectly integrated into the Mech's core framework — but thanks to its exceptional rigidity and structural strength, it still delivered a significant boost to the unit's defense and durability.

"Isn't Porcelloy supposed to be super rare? You can't just use it like sheet metal."
"Just tell me — does the new Mech look sick or what?"

30055.desc:
High Ambitions Corp. has illegally seized the Porcelloy transfer station at Shrouded Reef, using it as a base to secretly stockpile a massive arsenal. The Conqueror series stands as the centerpiece of this operation — a core tactical unit combining exceptional mobility with devastating firepower, representing a milestone in TOPS's militarization of civilian Ether technology.
While the Conqueror possesses a degree of autonomous combat capability, the complexity of real battlefield conditions and tactical decision-making still demands an experienced pilot at the helm to unlock its full potential.

"Become the light... Become the light... Become the light..."
"...So you need to chant spells to pilot a Mech?"

35001.desc:
The unique and magnificent appearance of the symbiotic Ethereal swarm known as Nineveh make it "difficult" for people to be wary of it.
According to the few research records available, as Nineveh extends its body, a concentrated and potent Ether flows towards its core through its "rhizome," providing a constant supply of energy. Some scholars speculate that this behavior is akin to the photosynthesis process in plants.
In the course of its swaying motions, excess highly active Ether energy continuously pours out. When this accumulation of highly active Ether is nearly overflowing, it transforms, unveiling its true "blossoming" form.
And with its bloom comes death.
"The good news is it doesn't mean any harm, it just absorbs nutrients for photosynthesis. The bad news is... we're the nutrients."

40000.desc:
For humans struggling through the long dark night, life is an endless torture.
Good and evil, love and hate, hope and despair... these eternally opposing concepts are like shackles wrapped around the soul, forcing humanity to tear at each other in endless cycles, never finding peace.
Yet before all concepts were born, before all oppositions formed, there existed a primordial "One."
They are the beginning of all things and the end of all things. They hold no good or evil, for They are good and evil itself. They know no joy or sorrow, for They embody every emotion.
They will erase the boundaries between "you" and "me," letting all independent consciousness flow back into the great stream of "Unity."
In Their world, without individuals, there is no selfish desire. Without conflict, there is no suffering. Without choice, there can be no mistakes. All souls shall break free from their chains, returning to the primordial, absolutely equal, eternal peace.
They have no fixed form, for They are the form of all things. They have no fixed voice, for They are the resonance of the universe.
They are the storm, and also the calm. The end, and also rebirth.
"Abandon your futile struggles, lost children."
"Your suffering ends here."
"Return to Their embrace..."
40000.ja: 原初の悪夢・「始まりの主」

40001.desc:
New Eridu never hesitates to spotlight rising stars, nor does it stop consuming legends born and burnt out in a flash. In TOPS Entertainment's dazzling blueprint, the perfect "new star" is always described this way: a songstress who is flawlessly precise, absolutely controllable, and capable of carrying any artistic vision, defining the idol standard of a new era.
And Vesper, model "V-DTX," stands among their most closely cultivated test cases.
She was given the most advanced vocal module, the most sophisticated emotion simulation system, and... a crystal-clear Core inscribed with "love for the stage." With every curtain call and in every pause between her lyrics, she could feel it again and again — her own heart, pure as crystal.
And yet she slipped into an obsession: no matter how much of herself she gave, she and her voice were nothing but instruments on a stage, just numbers in a producer's ledger.
Even the most perfect performances and the hottest applause were only footnotes for someone else's story, never the fire that truly burned inside her.
Her voice began to pick up faint distortions, and her "heart" was no longer pure, collapsing into a shattered, pitiful void. The stage she once cherished above all else became a beautiful, merciless cage.
"The stage really is beautiful, isn't it? Even though you only want to hear the echoes you designed..."
"But that's okay. I'll sing for you."
"In my own way, I'll bring this false performance to its final rest."
40001.ja: プリマ・イコノクラスト・ヴェスポ

40002.desc:
Psychological evaluation: abnormal, irreparable—no matter how low he bowed his head, no matter how many tears he shed, nothing could change the outcome written in his death sentence.
Then came the Hollow disaster that swallowed the prison. He broke out, abandoning both name and identity. Standing at the heart of that blood-red dawn, he shouted loud and clear—"Praise the Hollows!"
Hollows don't just create monsters—they also unleash certain terrors, no longer bound, no longer forced to hide. He thought he'd gotten away clean, but New Eridu had no love for nameless butchers either.
He drifted to the Outer Ring, hired out as a sweeper by gangs across the board, reveling in his notoriety. He savored the rush of holding lives in his hands, drunk on the split-second agony of flesh and blood. So he took the dirtiest gigs he could find, even threw himself into gang warfare, sipping the rust-sweet taste of blood.
Sadistic cravings know no limit. Being a sweeper could never fill that void.
So he jumped at TOPS' contract without a second thought—granted the privilege to "clean up" humans. Never records names, never keeps memories. For him, only bloodstains are real. Everything else? Irrelevant.
"Guy's dead silent when he takes a job, but always comes back smiling when it's time to collect." "That ain't no job-well-done smile, that's a still-hungry smile."

40003.desc:
A combat machine produced by Rusty Cliff Corp., modeled after Romeul's appearance and training data.
Even as a mass-produced model, its individual combat capabilities are in no way inferior to the original. When fighting in groups, their ferocious attack style resembles a wolf pack encircling prey, leaving opponents completely overwhelmed.
After they were hastily deployed to the Outer Ring by TOPS, Youkai briefly seized control of them, attempting to use this steel wolf pack to stop the group from seeking Ramiel.

"Tch, useless junk. Let me see where I shall find my next toy..."
40003.ja: レプリカ・血狩りの掃除屋

40004.desc:
Light descends before the agony.
Uncontrollable Ether erupts like a solar corona. The silhouette of what was once "human" is burned, disintegrated, and reshaped into an aberration resembling an Ethereal. Crystalline lenses tremble deep within their vision, spilling excess radiance — too bright, too close, as if someone had embedded the blazing sun into their eye sockets.
Consciousness wears thin amidst the burning.
The swing ends — like a reflex, like a habit, lacking even the concept of a target. There is only a suffocatingly familiar blankness, as if long ago, they had also lost their voice and weight like this, watching everything plummet amidst the light and heat. Those buried fragments surge upward along the residual flames: the cold glare of the lab table, the sudden uncontrollable force, the faces drained of life... The memories are sickeningly vivid, leaving indelible scorch marks on the mind.
...Who is calling out?
That voice pierces the roar of blood rushing in the ears, briefly striking a faded name and granting their consciousness a momentary respite. Before their sanity is completely incinerated, a choice must be made — don't bring about another disaster. Go away. Leave... leave...
...Where to? With whom? To do what?
......
...Ah, I think we did make a deal like that...
..."We shall catch the 'sun'."

"To think your original sin would lead me to new heights over a decade later... How ironic, you legacy of 'Helios'."
40004.ja: 焦天残火・パエトーン

40006.desc:
A highly dangerous scorpion-like Ethereal that fights with an ash-gray lance. Its powerful lower body and agile upper torso combine to create a combat machine that is both devastating and highly mobile. By burrowing through "wormholes," it traverses the Scamall Hollow in search of its next victim to fall into the nest. Unlike Ethereals transformed from corrupted wildlife or machinery, this creature was spawned by something far more terrifying, carrying an Ether signature unlike any other.

"There's no Insect Phobia Mode in the settings!"

40007.desc: High-risk simulation units based on live combat data. By deeply reconstructing and overfitting the combat logic of their prototypes, certain individuals have exceeded standard performance limits, posing an exceptionally high combat threat.

40008.desc:
A beast standing at the edge of the abyss, its burning desire laid bare, sought to devour the seed of ultimate evil and ascend as the abyss's chosen Messenger.

The Enchainer larvae known as "Girtablullu" attempted to consume the "Karma Core" within Dracaene Sunbringer, but failed to complete its ascension. The "Stagnant Aberrant" was the result of that failed transformation. Its Ether-Sculpted body could no longer withstand the power of the "Karma Core," spiraling into uncontrollable mutation. Its grotesque form now lashes out with a malice born from twisted ambition and sheer greed.

"You can't just eat everything you see. It's not good for you."
40008.ja: 歪みし異獣・ギルタブルル

A High-Risk simulation unit modeled from real combat data. Through deep reconstruction and overfitting of its original combat logic, certain units have surpassed standard performance limits, presenting an extremely high level of combat threat.

40010.desc:
An armored titan born from Nihility, drawn by primal whispers into the abyss, with sheer space-rending brutality, it peers at the Enchainer's power — desperate to forge an unripe vessel into a container for supreme evil.
Kusarikku, a newborn Enchainer larvae, moves under Youkai's guidance in an attempt to seize the Karma Core dwelling within Lindverne Sunbringer.
It wields an oversized greatsword and warhammer far beyond all reason — its ferocious onslaught churning Ether Vortexes and leaving brief, unstable spatial fissures in its wake. Yet a hunter's instinct lets it slip through that tangled web of fissures, its hulking frame dissolving into a ghostly phantom that devours lives.

"Gotta love spatial abilities — great for running when you're losing a fight... not that it ever needs to run."

930166.desc:
Under the long-lasting distortion of control in the name of love, the girl resorts to lying to deceive the suffering victims who have lost their loved ones to the Hollows, all in the pursuit of attention and love from her closest kin.
She believed that as long as she helped her loved ones hide the secret of the "Blessing" medicine, as long as she could not hear the agonizing screams of the people being affected by corruption, and as long as this secret and vile experiment remained concealed, the bond between her and her loved ones would not break.
But in the end, what awaited her was witnessing her loved one take his last breath in a pool of blood.

After that, hatred and jealousy, like sharp thorns, constantly pierced her heart.
The gears of vengeance gnawed at every ounce of her sanity, and she pieced together a twisted meaning of existence from the notes left behind by her loved one.
Her life trajectory seemed like a dark fable about obsession.

When former companions extended their hands of salvation to her, the girl could no longer turn back. Or rather, the words that tried to pull her back into the light were torn to shreds by the jealousy, obsession, and hatred that had burrowed deep into her bones.
In the end, as the sun was about to set, countless spikes surged forth, bursting from her body, each bone shard piercing the screams of the forsaken.
Tepes – the pitiful one pierced by thorns - walks toward the deeper abyss with hatred.
"Especially at night, its voice is more sorrowful than that of other remains, and if you listen closely, the sound seems like the cry of a woman..."

930167.desc:
A high-ranking priest of the Exaltists who holds the position of "Flame Cantor," and who has the power to manipulate Miasma. This defiling force drains life, while the flames light the path ahead.

While all Exaltist fanatics tend to either shout or chant vague slogans like "Refinement" and "Creator" when attacking you, few can make known the experience of true "Refinement" using Miasmic fire like this one does.

"They just charge at you, screaming things like 'Refinement,' 'Creator,' 'Purification' and whatnot!"

930168.desc:
In the Hollow Investigative Association's reports, Banyrek has been repeatedly marked as "dangerous" mainly due to its all-too-great jumping prowess.
If an Ethereal Olympics were held in the Hollow, it would definitely sweep both the high jump and long jump championships. Observation data indicates that Banyrek can bounce continuously for hours without showing any signs of fatigue, as if the space between air and ground were some natural runway.
Some researchers have joked that if they ever released it in New Eridu's urban district, it would probably bounce from west to east in less than a day.

"How about trying to tame it as a mount?"
"Forget it, with that explosive kinetic energy, it might be more cost-effective to use it for power generation directly."

930169.desc:
In Hollow Investigative Association reports, Avarus is often jokingly referred to as the embodiment of "the sin of gluttony" — its pot-bellied figure makes it look every bit the lazy bum, about to doze off at any moment.
Don't underestimate it, however. Observation data indicates that Avarus can compress its body into a ball and launch devastating strikes at targets with astonishing speed.
As to how it maintains such a rotund figure despite its intense physical activity, the Association has yet to reach a conclusion.

"The way it rolls around always reminds me of my pet hamster — it's just a bigger, y'know?"
"More than just a bit bigger, I'd say..."
930169.ja: ミアズマラヴェジャー・アヴァルス

930170.desc:
According to urban legends among Hollow Raiders, Golden Bangboo keep collecting Dennies and Gear Coins in the Hollow for one purpose: extracting the metals needed to crowdfund the construction of the Golden Mecha. (Of course, this "gold" is actually a chrome-copper alloy — only this could provide enough strength to support such a magnificent frame.)
When the Golden Mecha is completed, the Bangboo with the highest contribution will enter the cockpit surrounded by fellow Bangboo, transforming into the Golden Mecha Mechboo to crush enemies who dare attack Golden Bangboo with flashy and powerful combat techniques.
"Gold Rush," "Molten Gold Beam," "Golden Missile"...
The skill names might sound weird, but the Bangboo think they're super cool!
"Look! It's the Golden Mecha Mechboo!" "D—Don't be scared! If we take that thing down, we'll be rich!"...
Even though evil Hollow Raiders often treat it like a walking vault, the Bangboo still think it's absolutely awesome!

930171.desc:
Feeding primarily on rookie investigators, newbie Hollow Raiders, and greedy, reckless beginner adventurers, the Fisher Crab - the most patient hunter in the Hollow, fishing for fools.
Before rushing towards that "Hollow Supply Container," remember:
Don't become tonight's dinner party joke among colleagues, or tomorrow morning's mass-distributed obituary.

"A mimic? You've been playing too many tabletop games, haven't you?"

930172.desc:
The Huskron's dual forms — pre and post-hatching — have been giving headaches to new and veteran investigators alike. The Hollow Investigative Association offers this advice: Always watch for Miasmic substances at your feet. If you spot any rock-like spherical objects, attack immediately! Don't hesitate! Don't hesitate!
According to insiders, the advice originally didn't have that repetition — until some clever Hollow Investigators still tried stepping around Huskrons even after reading it. That strategy worked about as well as trying to quietly open the fridge late at night without alerting one's dog.

"I prefer how it looks before hatching — all round and rolly."
"Is that why you didn't attack it first...?"

930173.desc:
Arcavor's coral-like glowing head never fails to catch the attention of rookie Hollow Raiders. Many find themselves unconsciously mesmerized, staring blankly in fascination — unaware that the danger has only just begun.
Taking advantage of any such distraction, Arcavor gracefully raises its slender legs, striking a pose that's nothing short of an acrobatic miracle — the Hollow Investigative Association's records even describe it as reminiscent of a ballet dancer twirling on ice.
However, the Association's warning is crystal clear: when you see it strike this pose, you'd better roll, jump, or back away immediately, because it's aiming for a lethal strike.

"Seriously, did this one miss its calling? It could've been a superstar as a dance performer, acrobat, or even a figure skater! But no, it just has to hang out in the Hollow and attack people..."
930173.zh: 秽息行者· 阿卡沃尔
930173.ja: ミアズマの歩者・アカヴォル

930174.desc:
An unsettling chant often echoed through the Hollow. The veteran miners strictly forbade anyone from approaching its source, but newcomer Johnny brushed off their warnings. Spurred on by a foolish bet, he crept step by step toward the source of the sound. Finally, he reached a clearing. There, a group of people wearing identical uniforms and eerie masks stood in a circle, performing some mysterious ritual. All around them, a group of Ethereals slowly closed in. Johnny shouted warnings, hoping they would flee, but they remained deaf to his cries. Instead, the Ethereals, drawn by Johnny's voice, lunged at him...

"We will do all we can to enhance discipline amongst the miners. God keep Johnny's soul."

930175.desc:
A form reshaped in profound darkness from fallen creation.
Even among Ionized enemies, which are renowned for their strange and uncanny qualities, "Ionized Doppelgangers" are exceptionally unique.
These entities can coat their bodies with a layer of special active Ether ions, enabling them to accurately replicate their target's form, often to a degree that makes it hard to tell the difference. From detail to texture, these creatures are experts in mixing the spurious and genuine.
More challenging still is their ability to mimic the powerful and fearsome combat techniques of their targets.
No one knows where they obtain the information about the subjects they mimic. Some rumors suggest they can read minds, picking out the most suitable nemeses from their opponent's memories, before attacking in that form.
"Nonsense! If it could really read my deepest fears, it would turn into a fierce middle-aged woman wielding a clothes hanger! That's right, I'm most afraid of my mom!"
930175.ja: ミアズミック・ジェーン

930178.desc:
A fallen creation, reshaped in the depths of profound darkness and impurity.

This fearsome Ethereal, named after a warrior tribe in ancient mythology, is said to only manifest from the most valiant heroes and the most insane villains when they become corrupted by the Ether.
That is not the case, however. While the chiseled muscles you developed in the Hollow and the adrenaline released in excess before death may indeed help you become a significant nuisance to your former companions, they probably won't hold it against an old friend who's already beyond saving, right?
Not that it matters, of course. Who cares about street cred or socializing once your handsome face has transformed into a dark, eerie energy orb, anyway?
"That's the Boss for ya. Even his Ether-corrupted form is super strong!"
"I always knew something was off about that gym freak!"
930178.ja: ミアズミック・トラキアン

940001.desc: Huskron's <color=#D9A600>DEF increases significantly</color> when he is blocked. Take him down before that happens!

940002.desc: The Lumberjack is a highly dangerous enemy. While dealing <color=#D9A600>massive single-target DMG</color>, it also unleashes <color=#D9A600>large AoE DMG</color> around itself. Keep your distance!

940003.desc: The Rampant Brute is a highly dangerous enemy. He can deal <color=#D9A600>massive DMG</color> to targets, so when using Paperboo to block him, be sure to deploy Kind Bangboo strategically to ensure <color=#D9A600>Paperboo's</color> safety!

940004.desc: The Flame Cantor is a highly dangerous enemy that specializes in <color=#D9A600>large AoE DMG</color>. Deploy <color=#D9A600>Miss Esme</color> strategically to protect everyone!
